galleries.name: 中国古代青铜馆
galleries.description: 海内外体系最完整的古代青铜器阵列，展出500余件，涵盖夏代至清代3600年青铜艺术史
galleries.descriptionEN: One of the world's most complete displays of ancient Chinese bronzes, with over 500 objects spanning 3,600 years from the Xia to the Qing dynasty.
highlightsEN: Zi Zhong Jiang Pan (Spring and Autumn)
Jian Ri Zhi Guang Mirror (Western Han)

galleries.name: 雕塑馆
galleries.description: 289件/套骨雕、玉雕、青铜造像、木俑、陶俑，三分之一为首次公开展出
galleries.descriptionEN: 289 sculptures and figurines in bone, jade, bronze, wood and pottery; a third are on public display for the first time.

galleries.name: 第一特展厅（光明乳业）
galleries.description: 大型特展空间，举办'何以中国'系列等重磅特展
galleries.descriptionEN: Major special-exhibition hall hosting landmark shows such as the 'China: The Birth of a Civilization' series.

galleries.name: 中国古代玉器馆
galleries.description: 近350件/组玉器，从新石器时代至清代，六个单元呈现中国万年玉文化
galleries.descriptionEN: Nearly 350 jades from the Neolithic to the Qing dynasty, presented across six sections tracing ten millennia of Chinese jade culture.

galleries.name: 玺印篆刻馆
galleries.description: 568件印章，海内外首个中国印章专题陈列馆，展示印章史与全球古代文明的关系
galleries.descriptionEN: 568 seals - the world's first dedicated gallery on Chinese seals - exploring the history of seal art and its links to ancient civilizations worldwide.

galleries.name: 中国历代书法馆
galleries.description: 海内外唯一的常设通史书法陈列，展出多件国宝级书法名迹
galleries.descriptionEN: The only permanent, comprehensive survey of Chinese calligraphy in the world, featuring several national-treasure masterworks.

galleries.name: 中国历代绘画馆
galleries.description: 海内外唯一的常设通史绘画陈列，展出多年未公开展示的国宝级书画
galleries.descriptionEN: The only permanent, comprehensive survey of Chinese painting in the world, presenting national-treasure works long absent from public view.
highlightsEN: 'Gaoyi Tu' (Reclining Scholars), Tang, by Sun Wei

galleries.name: 第二特展厅（中国东方航空）
galleries.description: 大型特展空间，举办国际交流大展
galleries.descriptionEN: Major special-exhibition hall for international exchange exhibitions.

galleries.name: 上海书画馆
galleries.description: 探索江南文化、海派文化与红色文化，通过书画呈现上海文化脉络
galleries.descriptionEN: Exploring Jiangnan, Shanghai-school and revolutionary culture through painting and calligraphy, presenting the cultural lineage of Shanghai.

galleries.name: 中国古代陶瓷展
galleries.description: 中国陶瓷通史陈列，从新石器至明清，体系最完整的通史陈列之一
galleries.descriptionEN: A comprehensive history of Chinese ceramics from the Neolithic to the Ming-Qing, among the most complete surveys of its kind.

galleries.name: CeraMIX 陶瓷与中外交流馆
galleries.description: 全新常设展，通过陶瓷贸易讲述隋唐至明清中国与世界的经济文化交流
galleries.descriptionEN: A new permanent gallery tracing economic and cultural exchange between China and the world from the Sui-Tang to the Ming-Qing through ceramic trade.

galleries.name: 中国历代货币馆
galleries.description: 展出6000余枚钱币，规模翻倍，全面回顾中国货币金融发展史
galleries.descriptionEN: Over 6,000 coins - double the previous scale - offering a full survey of China's monetary and financial history.

galleries.name: 赵朴初书法馆
galleries.description: 纪念赵朴初(1907-2000)先生的书法艺术专题馆
galleries.descriptionEN: A gallery dedicated to the calligraphic art of Mr. Zhao Puchu (1907-2000).

galleries.name: 考古上海馆
galleries.description: 2000余件考古文物，追溯上海6000年城市演变史
galleries.descriptionEN: Over 2,000 archaeological artifacts tracing 6,000 years of Shanghai's urban evolution.

galleries.name: 江南文化馆
galleries.description: 现代极简风格融合江南文化元素，自然光与户外景观中品味文物
galleries.descriptionEN: A modern minimalist space blending Jiangnan cultural motifs, where artifacts are appreciated in natural light and garden views.

galleries.name: 第三特展厅
galleries.descriptionEN: Special-exhibition hall for international exchange shows.

galleries.name: 屋顶花园
galleries.description: 5楼屋顶花园，天气不好时临时关闭
galleries.descriptionEN: 5F rooftop garden; temporarily closed in bad weather.

floorSummary.1F: 青铜馆、雕塑馆、第一特展厅、服务中心、商店咖啡
floorSummary.2F: 玉器馆、玺印篆刻馆、书法馆、绘画馆、上海书画馆、第二特展厅、咖啡阶梯
floorSummary.3F: 陶瓷馆、CeraMIX馆、货币馆、赵朴初书法馆、第三特展厅、餐厅
floorSummary.4F: 考古馆、江南文化馆、茶室
floorSummary.B1: 东入口（丁香路方向）、存包处

floorSummaryEN.1F: Bronze, Sculpture, Special Exhibition Hall 1, service center, shop and cafe
floorSummaryEN.2F: Jade, Seal, Calligraphy, Painting, Shanghai Painting & Calligraphy, Special Exhibition Hall 2
floorSummaryEN.3F: Ceramics, CeraMIX, Numismatics, Calligraphy by Zhao Puchu, Special Exhibition Hall 3, restaurant
